definitions.explanation: One of the small engraved tiles used to play mahjong; a standard set has 136 tiles.

examples.japanese: {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: to line up the mahjong tiles.

examples.japanese: {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of mahjong tiles being shuffled.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{象牙|ぞうげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{高級品|こうきゅうひん}→高級品：21439_koukyuuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: These are a high-end set of mahjong tiles made of ivory.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{麻雀|まーじゃん}→麻雀：06986_maajan⟧ (mahjong) + ⟦{牌|ぱい}→牌：18361_pai⟧ (tile, playing piece).

- {麻雀|まーじゃん}{牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to stack tiles into walls
